title: Authority credit origins and eligible liability periods
topic: tax credit lots period eligibility refund cash liquidity appeal deadline
content: Enrolled schedules distinguish the initial overpayment credit lot from an additional appeal credit lot. Each actual authority event publishes a separate credit_lot_id, available_minor and allowed_period_ids. Initial credit can offset either listed period, subject to the schedule’s cumulative per-period offset ceilings. Appeal credit covers only its published periods. Neither a bank payment nor a pending appeal is credit. A lot’s cash refund or offset consumes the same available amount irreversibly; credit cannot be transferred from a paid period or applied twice. The original payment remains intact.

provenance.scope: Fictional authority credit scopes, appeal guarantees and timing, not real tax law.
